items.headline: Saints put Etienne (hamstring) on IR; out until at least Week 9
items.summary: Kellen Moore said Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take most of Etienne's snaps, and CJ Donaldson will handle short yardage. His carries are redistributed in the projection.

items.headline: Kamara leads the Saints backfield with Etienne on IR
items.summary: Etienne had 13 carries in Week 3 before leaving the game, compared with 9 for Kamara and 4 for Miller. Kamara should get the first shot at lead-back work, but he has been inefficient (2.8 yards per carry), and Miller will take a real share.

items.headline: Saints TE Fant (abdomen) questionable for Monday night vs. Falcons
items.summary: Fant is listed questionable on the Saints' final injury report for MNF, so his projection is trimmed 10%. Check inactives around 7:00 PM ET.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson (ankle) leaves win over Titans; Week 5 status unclear
items.summary: Jackson hurt his ankle on a sack late in the second quarter and didn't return. Tyler Huntley played the second half. Watch practice reports before the Week 5 game against Atlanta. If Huntley starts, expect more play-action looks for Zay Flowers.

items.headline: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) exits loss to Jaguars
items.summary: Chase left in the second quarter after a hard hit and is in the concussion protocol. Cincinnati could hold him out against Miami, with the Week 6 bye after that. Tee Higgins (16 targets Sunday) would be the No. 1 receiver.

items.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and Tank Bigsby both hurt vs. Rams
items.summary: Barkley got hurt in the first quarter after three touches. Bigsby ran 14 times for 55 yards in relief before leaving with a lower-body injury. The Eagles backfield is uncertain for Week 5 at Jacksonville.

items.headline: McConkey (foot) suffers setback, ruled out early in third quarter
items.summary: If McConkey misses Week 5 against Denver, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris lead the Chargers receivers, and Marquez Valdes-Scantling would see more work.

items.headline: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) leaves loss to Patriots
items.summary: Moore hurt his shoulder diving for a catch in the first half and didn't return. He was already playing through a shoulder issue this week.

items.headline: Mariota reinjured the MCL in his right knee; could miss several weeks
items.summary: Dan Quinn ruled Mariota out at halftime in London. Washington hopes Jayden Daniels (elbow) returns for Week 5 against the Giants. Otherwise rookie Athan Kaliakmanis starts.

items.headline: Chiefs WR Thornton dislocates ankle; Rashee Rice hurts hamstring
items.summary: Thornton is out indefinitely after a 55-yard catch, and Rice left early with a hamstring injury. Kansas City has a Week 5 bye and is talking with free agent Tyreek Hill. Xavier Worthy moves up.

items.headline: Monangai takes over Bears backfield from Swift, but hurt his thumb
items.summary: Monangai turned 31 touches into 28 points with two short TDs after D'Andre Swift fumbled and was benched in the third quarter. The thumb injury could shift work back to Swift for Week 5 against Green Bay.
